name: komdosh-dev-kotlin-extras
description: Niche maintenance tooling on top of spring-core — install only if you need one. /upgrade bumps one library at a time with the changelog's breaking changes mapped to the files they affect. /detect-flakes re-runs tests until it can classify each as deterministic or flaky, with evidence. /load-test-new scaffolds a Gatling simulation. Each surfaces and classifies; the specialists fix. Requires komdosh-dev-spring-core.
